name: iumrah-beta-update-20260918-booking-status-workspace-v1
root_cause: Pilgrim forms, payment details, receipts and travel documents lived primarily in a separate checkout screen, while Booking Status only showed progress. That split left the status timeline without the actionable data and persistent artifacts the traveler needs as the booking advances.
behavior: The main Booking hub no longer sends traveler/payment/document action cards to the separate checkout screen; those actions switch directly to Booking Status, where the content is embedded inline.
AVAILABILITY_CHECK: Booking Status shows one traveler card per pilgrim and keeps invoice/payment requisites hidden until availability is confirmed.
PAYMENT_PENDING: the same status workspace shows traveler forms, invoice, Gift/iUmrah Balance controls, payment method/requisites and receipt upload.

PAID / BOOKING_CONFIRMED / DOCUMENTS_READY: traveler data becomes read-only and fully visible; a permanent paid-receipt card appears together with airline ticket, hotel confirmation, visa and insurance preparation rows.

READY_TO_TRAVEL / IN_TRIP: the receipt and traveler cards remain pinned and rich outbound/return flight cards are added with segment flight number, airports, local dates/times, terminals, cabin, aircraft and baggage when available.

The paid receipt can be exported through the iOS share sheet as both PDF and PNG and contains a green PAID stamp, booking/iumrah ID, payer, recipient, iumrah platform, responsible person Aziz Kodirov, route, dates and total paid.
Track flight opens the existing iumrah Flights surface focused on the current bookingID; no unverified new AeroData endpoint or credential was invented in this patch.
deployment: No backend or Cloudflare files are changed; no PackageEngine deploy is required.
Build/TestFlight the iOS app after the patch is applied.
A full Xcode/iOS SDK build cannot run in the Linux patch environment; all 210 Swift source files were frontend-parsed successfully and the patch was overlay-tested against the supplied base archive.
